Exam point: Dargah-kshetra wale kund ka tapan 97.5 degree tha, jahan Hindu logon ko bhi snan ki anumati thi aur Ramzan me aath sau se barah sau aqidatmand ikattha hote the.

qe: Why did the Muslims of Telarha sometimes have to dig a grave three or four times over?
qh: तेलाढ़ा के मुसलमानों को कभी-कभी एक कब्र तीन-चार बार खोदनी पड़ती थी, इसका कारण क्या था?
oe: The graves kept collapsing after heavy rain
They refused to bury their relations in a tomb from which an idolatrous image or carving had been turned up
The soil there was too hard and rocky
Their custom demanded a new grave every day
oh: भारी बारिश के बाद कब्रें बैठ जाती थीं
वे ऐसी कब्र में दफनाना स्वीकार नहीं करते थे जहाँ से किसी प्रतिमा या मूर्तिकला का टुकड़ा निकला हो
वहाँ की मिट्टी बहुत कड़ी और पथरीली थी
उनकी परंपरा हर दिन नई कब्र की मांग करती थी
e: Telarha ki patthar ki masjid ek purane Bauddh mandir ke sthal par banayi gayi thi, aur uske aas-paas ki zameen me purani moortiyan, khamb tatha imaraton ke tukde bahut badi matra me dabe hue the. Isliye jab wahan koi qabr khodi jati thi, to usme se aksar Buddha ki moortiyan, khamb ya chhajje tatha gare ke tukde nikal aate the. Telarha ke Musalman aisi qabr me apne rishtedaron ko dafnana sweekar nahi karte the jahan se koi moorti ya but-kari ka tukda nikal aaya ho, isliye kabhi-kabhi ek hi qabr ko teen-char baar khod kar doosri jagah banana padta tha. Yah baat dikhati hai ki is kshetra me prachin Bauddh avshesh kitni adhik matra me milte hain. Exam point: Musalman us qabr me dafnana sweekar nahi karte the jahan se moorti ya but-kari ka tukda nikla ho, isliye kabhi ek qabr teen-char baar khodni padti thi.

qe: The dargah at Telarha belongs to which Muslim saint, who is greatly revered along with his six brothers whose tombs lie in neighbouring villages?
qh: तेलाढ़ा की दरगाह किस मुस्लिम संत की है, जो अपने छह भाइयों के साथ बहुत श्रद्धा के साथ पूजे जाते हैं और जिनकी कब्रें पड़ोसी गाँवों में हैं?
e: Telarha ki masjid ke darwazon ke bahar ek doosra ahata hai, jisme ek sant ki dargah yaani mazar hai. Yah dargah Saiyid Yusuf Ekbat ki hai, jo Telarha me lagbhag dhai sau saal pehle rahte the. Ilaake ke Musalman unhe aur unke chhah bhaiyon ko bahut mante hain; unke bhaiyon ki qabrein aas-paas ke Miawan, Mandaj, Abdalpur, Fatehpur, Parbalpur tatha Bibipur gaon me hain. Masjid tatha dargah dono ek unche teele par sthit hain, jo sambhavtah kisi Bauddh imarat ka sthal tha, aur gaon me kuchh bahut badhiya Bauddh moortiyan bhi mili hain. Is tarah ek hi kshetra me Bauddh, Hindu tatha Sufi paramparaon ke chinh ek saath milte hain. Exam point: Telarha ki dargah Saiyid Yusuf Ekbat ki hai, jinhe unke chhah bhaiyon ke saath ilaake ke Musalman bada mante hain.

qe: Of about a hundred Brahman families at Rajagriha, one half had become Bojoka and took the profits of the hills; what did this half of the families get from the Jains?
qh: राजगृह में लगभग सौ ब्राह्मण परिवारों में से आधे बोजोका बन गए थे तथा पहाड़ियों से होने वाली आय लेते थे; इन आधे परिवारों को जैनों से क्या मिलता था?
oe: A fixed yearly payment from the Jain merchants of the town
The right to bathe first at the hot springs
The land on which the Jain temples stood
A share in the offerings made at the Jain temples, whose care they took
oh: नगर के जैन व्यापारियों से हर साल तय रकम
गर्म पानी के कुंडों में सबसे पहले स्नान करने का अधिकार
जैन मंदिरों में चढ़ाए जाने वाले चढ़ावे में हिस्सा, जिनकी देखभाल वे करते थे
e: Rajgriho me lagbhag ek sau Brahman parivaron ke ghar the; inme se aadhe parivar Bojoka ban gaye the tatha pahadiyon se hone wali aay ka hissa lete the. Bojoka yaani woh Brahman jo mandiron ki dekhbhal tatha pooja ka kaam karte hain. Baaki aadhe parivar kuwon se hone wali aay lete the, jiska bada hissa Jain shraddhaluon ke chadhawe se aata tha. Dono paksh aapas me rishta tatha apni dharmik vidhiyan nibhate rehte the, chahe unka kaam alag tha. Isi kaaran Rajgir kshetra me kai sau saal tak Jain mandiron ki dekhbhal tatha pooja-kram chalta raha tatha mandiron se hone wali aay ka batwara pandon ke beech hota raha. Exam point: Rajgriho ke Brahman parivaron me se aadha hissa Bojoka ban gaya tha tatha unhe Jain mandiron ki dekhbhal tatha wahan chadhaye jane wale chadhawe me hissa milta tha, jabki doosra aadha hissa kuwon ki aay se chalata tha.

qe: The clay hut on the west side of the tank at Ongari, opposite the temple of the sun, was called what?
qh: ओंगारी में सूर्य मंदिर के सामने, तालाब के पश्चिम किनारे पर बनी मिट्टी की झोपड़ी को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Ongari ke talab ke pashchim kinare par, surya mandir ke saamne, mitti ki ek jhopdi yaani kachhi mitti se bani chhoti imarat thi, jise sarp ka niwas-sthan kaha jata tha. Sarp ke niwas ko Nagasthan kaha jata hai, kyunki lok-parampara me Naga yaani saanp ko paani tatha zameen ki upjau shakti ka rakhwala mana jata hai, isliye talabon ke paas aksar Naga-sthan bante the. Is jhopdi ke andar kai moortiyan rakhi thin, jinme teen kafi acchi halat me bachi thin - Gauri Shankar, Ganesa tatha Bauddh dharm ki ek moorti, jo sadharan mudra me baithi hui thi. Isi tarah ke chhote sthalon me alag-alag paramparaon ki moortiyan ek saath rakhi jaati thin, jisse gaon ke log purani moortikala ko sambhal kar rakh sakte the. Exam point: Ongari me surya mandir ke saamne wali mitti ki jhopdi ko sarp ka niwas yaani Nagasthan kaha jata tha tatha uske andar Gauri Shankar, Ganesa tatha baithi hui Buddha ki moorti rakhi thi.

qe: Which village of the Bihar subdivision, besides holding an annual fair, was a noted centre for the ceremony of circumcising Muhammadan children?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल का कौन-सा गाँव सालाना मेला लगाने के साथ-साथ मुस्लिम बच्चों के ख़तना करने की रस्म का भी प्रसिद्ध केंद्र था?
e: Hilsa Bihar subdivision ka Kattar nadi ke kinare basa ek gaon hai, jahan bada bazaar lagta tha tatha jisme anaaj yaani anaj tatha tilhan ki kharid-farokht hoti thi. Yahan ek saalana mela bhi lagta tha, tatha yah kshetra apne aas-paas ke Muhammadan parivaron ke liye ladkon ka khatna yaani sunnat karane ki rasm ka bhi mukhya kendra mana jata tha. Gaon ke paas hi Shah Juman Madari ki dargah tatha unke naam se judi purani masjid hai, isliye yah sthal ziyarat yaani dargah-darshan ka bhi kendra raha. Ek hi gaon me dargah, saalana mela tatha khatna jaise sanskar ka kendra hona dikhata hai ki aise sthal dharmik tatha samajik jeevan ka mel ban jate the. Exam point: Hilsa me bada bazaar tatha saalana mela lagta tha tatha yah khatna ki rasm ka mukhya kendra tha; yah gaon Kattar nadi ke kinare Shah Juman Madari ki dargah ke liye bhi prasiddh hai.

qe: Among the Mundas, Birhors and Hos of Bihar, by which name is the Supreme Being, the creator of the entire universe, known?
qh: बिहार के मुंडा, बिरहोर तथा हो जनजातियों में सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्मांड के रचयिता सर्वोच्च ईश्वर को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Bihar ki sabhi janjatiyan, Paharia janjati ke atirikt, ek sarvasochch yaani Supreme Being me vishwas karti hain, jo sampoorn brahmand ka rachiyta yaani creator hai. Yeh Bhagwan sarvavyapi yaani all-pervasive tatha kalyan-kari yaani benevolent shakti hai, jiske sabhi chhote devta tatha aatmaen aagyakaari hain. Lekin woh itna uncha tatha manav-karya se alag hai ki uski niyamit puja nahi hoti tatha uske liye koi moorti ya prateek bhi nahi hota. Munda, Birhor tatha Ho janjatiyon me is Sarvochch Bhagwan ko 'Sing Bonga' kaha jaata hai. Isi tarah Khariaon me use 'Parameswar' ya 'Bhagwan', Oraon me 'Dharmes' tatha Santhal me 'Chando' ya 'Thakur' kaha jaata hai. Exam point: Munda, Birhor tatha Ho janjatiyon me sarvochch Bhagwan ko 'Sing Bonga' kaha jaata hai, jiske liye koi moorti ya prateek nahi hota tatha niyamit puja bhi nahi hoti.

qe: Among the Oraons of Bihar, the Supreme Being is known by which name?
qh: बिहार के उराँव जनजाति में सर्वोच्च ईश्वर को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Bihar ki janjatiyon me ek sarvasochch yaani Supreme Being me vishwas milta hai, jo sampoorn brahmand ka rachiyta hai tatha ek sarvavyapi tatha kalyan-kari shakti ke roop me dekha jaata hai. Is Bhagwan ke alag-alag naam alag-alag janjatiyon me prachlit hain: Khariaon me use 'Parameswar' ya 'Bhagwan' kaha jaata hai, Santhal me 'Chando' ya 'Thakur', aur Oraon janjati me 'Dharmes'. Munda, Birhor tatha Ho me ise 'Sing Bonga' kehte hain. Is tarah ek hi sarvasochch shakti ki sankalpana alag-alag janjatiyon me alag-alag naam se vyakt hoti hai, lekin uski puja ki vidhi tatha manyatayen ek jaisi rehti hain. Exam point: Oraon janjati me sarvochch Bhagwan ko 'Dharmes' kaha jaata hai, jabki Khariaon me 'Parameswar' ya 'Bhagwan' tatha Santhal me 'Chando' ya 'Thakur'.

qe: In the tribal religion of Bihar, which tribe does not believe in one Supreme Being who is the creator of the universe?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय धर्म में कौन-सी जनजाति एक सर्वोच्च ईश्वर, जो ब्रह्मांड का रचयिता है, में विश्वास नहीं करती?
e: Bihar ki sabhi janjatiyan, keval Paharia janjati ke atirikt, ek sarvasochch yaani Supreme Being me vishwas karti hain, jo sampoorn brahmand ka rachiyta hai tatha ek sarvavyapi tatha kalyan-kari shakti maana jaata hai. Is Bhagwan ke sabhi chhote devta tatha aatmaen aagyakaari hote hain, lekin woh khud manav ke karya-kshetra se itna door maana jaata hai ki uski koi niyamit puja nahi hoti tatha uske liye koi moorti ya prateek bhi nahi hota. Iske neeche gaon ke devta aate hain, jin ki puja Sarna me gaon ka purohit alag-alag tyoharon ke avsar par karta hai. Is tarah janjatiya dharm me dharmik vishwas ki ek sopan-vyavastha yaani hierarchy dikhti hai. Exam point: Paharia janjati ke atirikt Bihar ki sabhi janjatiyan ek sarvasochch Bhagwan me vishwas karti hain, jiske liye koi moorti ya prateek nahi hota tatha jiski niyamit puja nahi hoti.

qe: How is worship offered to the village deities in the Sarna of a tribal village?
qh: जनजातीय गाँव के सरना में गाँव के देवताओं की पूजा किस प्रकार की जाती है?
oe: The priest chants certain formulae and sacrifices fowls, goats or sheep in the name of the deity
The villagers bathe the idols in milk and offer gold coins
Only the headman recites the Vedas before the deity
The deity is worshipped by fasting for a whole month
oh: पुजारी कुछ मंत्र पढ़ता है तथा देवता के नाम पर मुर्गे, बकरी या भेड़ की बलि चढ़ाता है
गाँव के लोग मूर्तियों को दूध से स्नान कराते हैं तथा स्वर्ण-सिक्के चढ़ाते हैं
केवल मुखिया देवता के सामने वेद पढ़ता है
देवता की पूजा पूरे महीने उपवास करके की जाती है
e: Gaon ke devtaon ki puja Sarna me gaon ke purohit yaani priest dwara alag-alag tyoharon ke avsar par ki jaati hai. In devtaon me kuch kalyan-kari yaani benevolent hote hain tatha kuch hanikarak yaani malevolent. Rog-devtaon yaani disease-deities ko keval tab prasan kiya jaata hai jab koi mahamari yaani epidemic phoot padti hai; gaon tatha uske nivasiyon ki samriddhi ke liye aise kai devtaon tatha unke alag-alag naam (jo janjati-dar-janjati badalte hain) ko prasann rakhna padta hai. Puja me purohit kuch nirdharit mantron ka uchcharan karta hai tatha devta ke naam par murge, bakri ya bhed ki bali deta hai. Yeh bali ek sanskar yaani sacrament me badal jaati hai, jise poora samuday grahan karta hai. Gaay-bail jaise bade pashu aam taur par devtaon ko bali nahi diye jaate. Exam point: Sarna me gaon ka purohit mantron ka uchcharan karke devta ke naam par murge, bakri ya bhed ki bali deta hai; yeh bali poore samuday dwara grahan kiye jaane wale sanskar me badal jaati hai tatha bade pashu aam taur par bali nahi diye jaate.

qe: In tribal Bihar, who appeases the malevolent spirits that are believed to cause illness?
qh: जनजातीय बिहार में उन दुष्ट आत्माओं को कौन प्रसन्न करता है जो रोग उत्पन्न करती मानी जाती हैं?
oe: The clan elders in a panchayat
The Ojha or Mati, a special priest
oh: ओझा या माटी, जो विशेष पुजारी है
e: Janjatiya log bahut si dushkarmi yaani malevolent aatmaon me vishwas karte hain, jinhe rog yaani illness hone par prasann karna padta hai. In aatmaon se nipatne ka kaam 'Ojha' yaani vishesh purohit ya 'Mati' karta hai; sadharan purohit in aatmaon se nahi nipat sakte. Isi tarah maut ke baad marne wale ki chhaya yaani shade ko saanskarik roop se us gupt sthal tak pahunchaya jaata hai, jo rasoi ke ek kone me poorvajon ki aatmaon yaani ancestral spirits ka ghar hota hai; khaas avsaron par poorvajon ki puja bhi ki jaati hai. Totem yaani kul-chinha ke roop me kisi jaanwar ya paudhe ka samman to kiya jaata hai, lekin unki puja nahi hoti tatha koi totem-sanskar bhi nahi hote; ek janjatiya vyakti apne totem ke virudh kuch bhi nahi karta. Exam point: Janjatiya Bihar me rog karne wali dushkarmi aatmaon ko 'Ojha' ya 'Mati' naamak vishesh purohit prasann karta hai, jabki sadharan purohit in aatmaon se nahi nipat sakte.

qe: In the tribal belief of Bihar, what is 'Bonga'?
qh: बिहार की जनजातीय मान्यता में 'बोंगा' क्या है?
oe: A drum used in tribal dances
An impersonal power, at once sacred and powerful, of which the deities and spirits are repositories
A village deity worshipped only during epidemics
A priest who performs the marriage ceremony
oh: एक निर्वैयक्तिक शक्ति, जो एक साथ पवित्र तथा शक्तिशाली है और जिसके भंडार देवता एवं आत्माएँ हैं
केवल महामारी के समय पूजा जाने वाला गाँव का देवता
e: Janjatiya vishwas me pahadon, nadiyon, jangalon tatha pedon me nivas karne wali aatmaen hoti hain. Gaon ke devtaon tatha in aatmaon sabhi ko 'Bonga' ka bhandaar yaani repository maana jaata hai. Bonga ek nirvaivyaktik yaani impersonal shakti hai, jo ek hi samay me pavitra tatha shaktishali hoti hai; iski tulna 'Mana' naamak shakti se ki jaati hai jo kai dharmik paramparaon me payi jaati hai. Kuch janjatiya gaonon me Mahadeo, Kali tatha anya devi-devtaon ki puja bhi milti hai, jo bahari dharmik prabhav ka parinaam hai. Is tarah janjatiya dharm me sarvochch Bhagwan, gaon ke devta, rog-devta tatha prakritik aatmaon ki ek alag-alag shreni hoti hai, jinhe 'Bonga' ki sankalpana se samjha jaata hai. Exam point: Bonga ek nirvaivyaktik shakti hai, jo pavitra tatha shaktishali hoti hai tatha jiske bhandaar gaon ke devta tatha pahad, nadi, jungle aadi ki aatmaen hote hain; iski tulna 'Mana' se ki jaati hai.

qe: After a death in a tribal family of Bihar, where is the 'shade of the dead' ceremonially conducted to reside?
qh: बिहार के किसी जनजातीय परिवार में मृत्यु के बाद मृतक की छाया को औपचारिक रूप से कहाँ निवास करने के लिए पहुँचाया जाता है?
oe: To the Sasan, the bone burial ground outside the village
To the Akhara, the dancing ground of the village
To the secret tabernacle in a corner of the kitchen, which is the home of ancestral spirits
To the Sarna, the sacred grove of the village
oh: गाँव के बाहर अस्थि-निक्षेप स्थल सासन में
रसोई के एक कोने में स्थित गुप्त पवित्र स्थान, जो पूर्वजों की आत्माओं का घर है
गाँव के पवित्र उपवन सरना में
e: Janjatiya vishwas me maut ke baad marne wale ki chhaya yaani shade ko saanskarik roop se vidhi-poorvak us gupt pavitr sthal tak pahunchaya jaata hai, jo rasoi ke ek kone me sthit hota hai tatha poorvajon ki aatmaon ka ghar maana jaata hai. Khaas avsaron par poorvajon ki aatmaon ki puja bhi ki jaati hai. Isi tarah Munda, Oraon, Kharia tatha Ho janjatiyon me asthi-dafan yaani bone-burial ka samaroh har saal hota hai, jisme saal bhar me marne wale logon ke avshesh unke kul ke 'Sasan' me dafna diye jaate hain. Maut poore parivar ko ashuddh yaani polluted kar deti hai tatha yeh sthiti shuddhikaran ke samaroh ke baad hi khatm hoti hai. Exam point: Maut ke baad marne wale ki chhaya ko rasoi ke kone me sthit gupt tabernacle tak pahunchaya jaata hai, jo poorvajon ki aatmaon ka ghar hota hai; Munda, Oraon, Kharia tatha Ho me asthi-dafan ka samaroh har saal kul ke Sasan me hota hai.

qe: In the tribal religion of Bihar, what is the attitude towards totemistic objects such as the animals and plants of a clan?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय धर्म में कुल के पशु-पक्षी तथा पौधों जैसे टोटम-चिह्नों के प्रति क्या दृष्टिकोण है?
oe: They are objects of reverence, but no worship is offered to them and there are no totemistic ceremonies
They are worshipped daily with offerings of rice beer
They are sacrificed at every village festival
They are completely ignored as meaningless objects
oh: वे श्रद्धा के पात्र हैं, लेकिन उनकी पूजा नहीं की जाती तथा कोई टोटम-संस्कार भी नहीं होता
उनकी प्रतिदिन चावल की दारू चढ़ाकर पूजा की जाती है
गाँव के प्रत्येक त्योहार पर उनकी बलि दी जाती है
उन्हें अर्थहीन वस्तु मानकर पूरी तरह उपेक्षित किया जाता है
e: Janjatiya dharm me totem yaani kul-chinha ke roop me kisi jaanwar ya paudhe ka samman to kiya jaata hai, lekin unki koi puja nahi hoti tatha koi totem-sanskar bhi nahi hote. Ek janjatiya vyakti apne totem ke virudh kuch bhi nahi karta; jaise jis kul ka totem koi jaanwar ho, woh us jaanwar ko koi hani nahi pahunchata. Iske alawa mrug tatha pakshi, nadi-jangal ki aatmaen, gaon ke devta tatha poorvajon ki aatmaen janjatiya puja ke anya mahatvapurn kendra hain. Puja me purohit mantron ka uchcharan karta hai tatha devta ke naam par pashu-bali deta hai, jise poora samuday sanskar ke roop me grahan karta hai. Exam point: Janjatiya dharm me totem-yaani kul-chinha ke prati shraddha hoti hai, lekin unki puja ya koi totem-sanskar nahi hota tatha vyakti apne totem ke virudh kuch bhi nahi karta.

qe: Sarhul, one of the most popular tribal festivals of Chotanagpur, is observed on which day?
qh: छोटानागपुर का सबसे लोकप्रिय जनजातीय त्योहार सरहुल किस दिन मनाया जाता है?
oe: The first day of the month of Kartik
The full moon of the month of Phalgun
The new moon of the month of Ashadh
The last day of the month of Baisakh
e: Janjatiya logon ka dharmik utsah un hazaron tyoharon me vyakt hota hai jo kheti ke calendar ke alag-alag charanon yaani stages par manaye jaate hain; inme Sarhul, Naukhi, Parab, Karma, Tusu, Sohrai aadi pramukh hain. Sarhul Baisakh mahine ke antim din manaya jaata hai tatha Chotanagpur ke sabse lokpriya tyoharon me ginti me aata hai. Yeh aboriginals yaani mool nivaasiyon ka vasant-utsav yaani spring festival hai tatha dakshin Bihar me itna vyapak hai ki ise sarvajanik avkash yaani public holiday ghoshit kar diya gaya hai. Is avsar par gaon ke purohit Sarna me phool tatha murge, bakri ya bhed jaise bali arpan karte hain. Is din gaon me bahut harshosh tatha utsav hota hai tatha purush tatha mahilaen saaz ke saath raat bhar nritya karte hain. Exam point: Sarhul Baisakh mahine ke antim din manaya jaata hai tatha Chotanagpur ka sabse lokpriya tyohar hai, jise dakshin Bihar me sarvajanik avkash ghoshit kiya gaya hai.

qe: Which of the following are the tribal festivals of Bihar that mark the different stages of the agricultural calendar?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से बिहार के जनजातीय त्योहार हैं, जो कृषि-पंचांग के विभिन्न चरणों को चिह्नित करते हैं?
oe: Christmas, Easter, Good Friday and Lent
Sarhul, Naukhi, Parab, Karma, Tusu and Sohrai
oh: क्रिसमस, ईस्टर, गुड फ्राइडे तथा लेंट
सरहुल, नौखी, परब, कर्मा, टुसू तथा सोहराय
e: Janjatiya logon ka dharmik utsah un bahut se tyoharon me vyakt hota hai jo kheti ke calendar ke alag-alag charanon yaani stages par manaye jaate hain. Inme Sarhul, Naukhi, Parab, Karma, Tusu, Sohrai aadi mukhya hain. Sarhul Baisakh mahine ke antim din manaya jaata hai tatha Chotanagpur ka sabse lokpriya tyohar hai, jise dakshin Bihar me sarvajanik avkash ghoshit kiya gaya hai. Is avsar par gaon ke purohit Sarna me phool tatha murge, bakri ya bhed ki bali arpan karte hain tatha gaon ke log raat bhar nritya-gayan karte hain. Is tarah yeh tyohar keval manoranjan nahi the, balki kheti tatha prakriti se jude dharmik sanskaron ka ang the. Exam point: Sarhul, Naukhi, Parab, Karma, Tusu tatha Sohrai Bihar ke janjatiya tyohar hain, jo kheti ke calendar ke alag-alag charan chinhit karte hain tatha jisme Sarhul sabse lokpriya hai.

qe: Which home-brewed rice-beer of the tribal people of Bihar is noted as being rich in vitamin content and also has an important role in tribal worship?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय लोगों की कौन-सी घर पर बनी चावल की दारू विटामिन से भरपूर मानी जाती है तथा जनजातीय पूजा में भी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है?
e: Janjatiya bhojan me ubla hua chawal mukhya bhojan hai tatha adhiktar logon ke liye saal ke chaar mahine se zyada kam-khaane ka daur yaani spare diet ke saath guzara karna padta hai, jisme gondli, millet tatha mahua khaye jaate hain. Iske saath hi janjatiya log gharon par chawal ki dhaaru yaani rice-beer banate hain, jise 'Hanria' ya 'Ili' kaha jaata hai. Yeh peya vitamin se bharpur maana jaata hai tatha janjatiya puja me iski ek mahatvapurn bhoomika hoti hai, kyunki bali tatha bhoj ke samay iska istemal hota hai. Is tarah yeh peya keval khady nahi, balki janjatiya sanskritik tatha dharmik jeevan ka bhi ang hai. Exam point: Janjatiya logon ki gharelu chawal ki dhaaru yaani rice-beer ko 'Hanria' ya 'Ili' kaha jaata hai, jo vitamin se bharpur hoti hai tatha janjatiya puja me bali aadi ke samay mahatvapurn bhoomika nibhati hai.

qe: In the tribal dress of Bihar, what are 'Kareya' and 'Paria'?
qh: बिहार की जनजातीय वेशभूषा में 'करेया' तथा 'परिया' क्या हैं?
oe: The ceremonial dress of a man and of a woman respectively
A wooden comb and a glass bead necklace
A rice-beer pot and a dancing drum
The bride-price of a Munda and a Ho marriage
oh: क्रमशः पुरुष तथा महिला की औपचारिक वेशभूषा
लकड़ी की कंघी तथा काँच की माला
चावल की दारू का घड़ा तथा नृत्य का ढोल
मुंडा तथा हो विवाह का वर-मूल्य
e: Janjatiya yuva purush ki paramparik veshbhusha kamar ke charon or lapeti gayi kapde ki ek patli patti hoti hai, jise peechhe ki or baandha jaata hai. Purush ki sanskarik yaani ceremonial veshbhusha ko 'Kareya' tatha mahila ki sanskarik veshbhusha ko 'Paria' kaha jaata hai. Bahut si janjatiyaen apni safai ke liye jaani jaati hain; bachhe saat-ath saal ki umar tak nange rehte the. Padhe-likhe ya dharmantarit janjatiya purush bahar jaane ke liye dhoti tatha shirt rakhte the, jabki mahilaen mill ke bane sari tatha cotton blouse pehenti thin. Aam taur par purushon tatha mahilaon dono ke shareer ka upari hissa khula rehta tha tatha keval ajnabiyon ke saamne mahilaen apna vaksha-kshetra dhak leti thin. Exam point: Janjatiya purush ki sanskarik veshbhusha ko 'Kareya' tatha mahila ki sanskarik veshbhusha ko 'Paria' kaha jaata hai; aam jeevan me kamar par lapete kapde ki patti paramparik veshbhusha thi.

qe: The Naukhia Parab of the tribal people of Bihar is held on the last day of which month, when the first fruits of the new crop are offered to the presiding deity of the village?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय लोगों का नौखिया परब किस महीने के अंतिम दिन मनाया जाता है, जब नई फसल का पहला फल गाँव के अधिष्ठाता देवता को चढ़ाया जाता है?
e: Janjatiya Bihar ke tyohar mool roop se krishi yaani kheti ke charnon se jude hote hain. Naukhia Parab Asarh mahine ke aakhri din manaya jaata hai, jab nayi fasal ka pehla hissa yaani first fruits gaon ke adhishthata devta yaani presiding deity ko chadhaya jaata hai. Is din kheti karne wale log kaam se dur rehte hain yaani kheti ka kaam nahi karte. Is tarah ke tyoharon ka uddeshya nayi fasal ke liye devtaon ka aabhar prakat karna tatha aane wale samay ke liye unka aashirwad lena hota hai. Tyohar ke din gaon me bhoj, nritya tatha geet ka aayojan bhi hota hai, jisse samajik ekta badhti hai. Sarhul, Naukhi, Parab, Karma, Tusu tatha Sohrai jaise tyohar krishi-chakra ke alag-alag charnon ko darshate hain. Exam point: Naukhia Parab Asarh mahine ke aakhri din manaya jaata hai, jab nayi fasal ka pehla fal gaon ke adhishthata devta ko arpit kiya jaata hai tatha kheti karne wale log us din kaam nahi karte.

qe: In the month of Bhado, the Karma festival of the tribal people of Bihar is observed by planting a branch of which tree in the Akhara?
qh: भादो महीने में बिहार के जनजातीय लोगों का करमा त्योहार अखाड़ा में किस पेड़ की टहनी लगाकर मनाया जाता है?
e: Karma tyohar janjatiya tatha gair-janjatiya, dono logon dwara manaya jaata hai. Bhado mahine me Sal ped ki ek shakha yaani branch gaon ke Akhara me lagayi jaati hai tatha uski puja tatha bali di jaati hai. Isse pehle chaubees ghante ka upvaas yaani twenty-four hours ka fasting kiya jaata hai, jisme log kuchh nahi khaate. Us raat ko Akhara me lagayi gayi shakha ke aas-paas nritya tatha geet ke saath samay bitaya jaata hai. Gaayak Karma tatha Dharma ki lambi gatha yaani legend sunate hain, jo is tyohar ki lok-katha hai. Akhara janjatiya gaon ka woh sthal hai jahan yuvak-yuvatiyan nritya tatha sangeet ka abhyas karte hain tatha samajik karyakram hote hain. Exam point: Karma tyohar Bhado mahine me manaya jaata hai, jisme Sal ped ki shakha Akhara me lagakar puja ki jaati hai; isse pehle chaubees ghante ka upvaas hota hai tatha raat bhar nritya-geet ke saath Karma-Dharma ki gatha sunayi jaati hai.

qe: Among the Santhals of Bihar, the Sohrai festival is celebrated after the paddy harvest in December-January; for how many days does this festival last?
qh: बिहार के संथालों में सोहराय त्योहार दिसंबर-जनवरी में धान की कटाई के बाद मनाया जाता है; यह त्योहार कितने दिन चलता है?
e: Santhal janjati me Sohrai tyohar dhan yaani paddy ki katai ke baad, December-January me manaya jaata hai. Yeh tyohar paanch din tak chalta hai, jisme gaushala yaani cattle-shed ke adhishthata devtaon tatha purvajon ki aatmaon yaani ancestral spirits ki puja ki jaati hai. Ghar ke pashuon ko saaf kiya jaata hai tatha sajaya jaata hai; isliye ise pashuon ki puja ka tyohar bhi kaha ja sakta hai. Diwali ke agle din bhi Sohrai manaya jaata hai, jisme gharelu pashuon ki pooja tatha shringaar hota hai. Kuchh videshi lekhakon ne Sohrai tatha Mage Parab ke dauran nachne-gaane tatha khul-mil kar aish karne ko badha-chadha kar likha hai, lekin asliyat me is tarah ke varnan bahut badha-chadha kar kiye gaye hain. Exam point: Santhalon ka Sohrai tyohar dhan ki katai ke baad December-January me paanch din tak manaya jaata hai, jisme gaushala ke devtaon tatha purvaj aatmaon ki puja hoti hai.

qe: Among the Hos of Bihar, which festival, lasting for several days, is an occasion for great festivity and enjoyment?
qh: बिहार के हो जनजाति में कौन-सा त्योहार कई दिनों तक चलता है तथा बड़े उल्लास और आनंद का अवसर होता है?
e: Mage Parab Ho janjati ka ek mahatvapurn tyohar hai, jo kai dinon tak chalta hai tatha bade ullas tatha aanand ka avsar hota hai. Janjatiya tyoharon me Sarhul (Baisakh ke aakhri din), Naukhia Parab (Asarh ke aakhri din), Karma (Bhado) tatha Sohrai (dhan ki katai ke baad) aadi shaamil hain. Ho janjati Chotanagpur kshetra me rehti hai tatha uski sanskriti, nritya tatha tyohar Bihar ki sanskritik vividhta ka mahatvapurn hissa hain. Hindu logon ke nazdeek ke kshetron me rehne wale Adivasi Holi tatha Dassehra jaise tyohar bhi bade utsah ke saath manate hain tatha us samay melon ka aayojan hota hai. Exam point: Ho janjati ka Mage Parab kai dinon tak chalta hai tatha bade ullas-aanand ka avsar hota hai; isi tarah Hindu kshetron ke nazdeek rehne wale Adivasi Holi tatha Dassehra bhi bade utsah se manate hain.

qe: In the Munda areas of Bihar, the big fairs that take the form of very big bazaars where business is combined with entertainment are held at which time?
qh: बिहार के मुंडा क्षेत्रों में वे बड़े मेले, जो बहुत बड़े बाजारों का रूप लेते हैं और जहाँ व्यापार के साथ मनोरंजन भी जुड़ा होता है, किस समय लगते हैं?
oe: During the Sarhul festival in Baisakh
At the time of sowing in Asarh

e: Munda kshetron me fas yaani harvest ke theek baad, December tatha January mahine me kai jagah bade melon ka aayojan hota hai. Yeh mele bahut bade bazar (bazaar) ka roop lete hain, jahan vyapar yaani business ke saath-saath manoranjan bhi hota hai; isliye yeh keval dharmik ya krishi-anushthan nahi, balki aarthik tatha samajik milan ke bhi kendra hote hain. Aise melon me kisan apni upaj bechte hain, gharelu tatha hath se bane saamaan ki kharid-farokht hoti hai tatha nritya-geet tatha khel-tamasha bhi hote hain. Janjatiya arthavyavastha me yeh mele vyapar tatha samajik sampark ka mahatvapurn sadhan the, kyunki door-daraz ke gaon ke log yahan ek jagah ikattha hote the. Exam point: Munda kshetron me fasl ki katai ke turant baad, yaani December-January me bade mele lagte hain, jo vishal bazar ke roop me vyapar tatha manoranjan, dono ko ek saath le kar chalte hain.
